reader.requirement: At --std 85, STANDARD-DEVIATION returns zero when the series is a single value (one literal, item or element) or consists only of variable-occurrence (ODO) items whose total occurrences are one; each ALL must yield at least one argument (§1989:A.2.2 AR4).

edition-consulted.switches: D8 edition window: sig.IntroducedIn (85 for the 1989 module rows, IntrinsicCatalog.cs#Build) against ctx.Edition.DialectLevel; COBOL1502/1503 outside it

ConstructRegistry NumericFunctionIdentifierOperand2002: at 85 a numeric/integer function written where an identifier stands (MOVE sender) is refused (COBOL0900), per §1989:A.2.3 GR2/GR3; never reached inside an arithmetic expression
Edition.DigitCapacityExcess: 18-digit cap on items and literals at 85 (31 later); bounds the argument range only
num.StandardDecimal (OPTIONS ARITHMETIC, a 2002+ paragraph, so always native at 85): the native dispatch is the one a 2023 program with no ARITHMETIC clause takes

reader.edition-search: grep of IntrinsicBinder.cs, IntrinsicRenderer.cs, IntrinsicCarrierRules.cs, FunctionValueLane.cs for Edition|DialectLevel|CobolVersion|ArithmeticMode|StandardDecimal; the runtime bodies take no edition input
reader.witnesses-cover: part: witnesses cover SD/VARIANCE of a single literal; not an ODO table(ALL) whose DEPENDING ON value is 1, a single ODO element, or a single negative item

probes.printed: SD(T(1))=0; SD(T(ALL) T(ALL)) with N=1 (two equal values)=0

citations.check: OK  §1989:A.2.41.4 RV3  (2.41.4 Returned Values)  the text is in RV3
OK  §1989:A.2.2 AR4  (2.2 ARGUMENTS**)  the text is in AR4

reader.notes: The table(ALL) enumeration reads the ODO object at run time, so a one-occurrence table becomes a one-element list. The exact variance of one value is 0, and so is its root. Output was identical at --std 2023.

refuter.evidence: rsd1-002 (--std 85): ODO entry DX OCCURS 1 TO 5 DEPENDING ON N with subordinate DY OCCURS 2, N=1: SD(DY(ALL 1)) = 0 and SD(DY(ALL 2)) = 0 (variable-occurrence items, total one occurrence); one 18-digit item SD(A1) = 0; one float value SD(FUNCTION SQRT(2)) = 0; one expression SD(A1 / 3) = 0; SD(DY(1 1)) = 0 in a relation condition. Two variable-occurrence references each give at least one argument (§1989:A.2.2 AR4), so 'total one' is reachable only by a single reference, which the probes cover. cite.py: 'OK  §1989:A.2.41.4 RV3  (2.41.4 Returned Values)  the text is in RV3'.
